title: New filing
covers: small business - only a bank statement

steps.say: The guided way in: say who the return is for, see the documents it needs, drop them in - {product} reads each one, makes the client and asks only for what is missing.
A person, an HUF, a partnership firm, an LLP, an AOP or BOI, or a company - each card starts its own filing. A trust says Not yet, with what to do meanwhile.
One worked example for each kind of return, with made-up documents: Watch how plays it start to finish.
Every filing not finished waits here. Carry on opens it where you left off; Discard drops the wizard's progress, never the client or the return.
What you're filing, the documents, the upload, the review. Progress is saved as you go - leave, and carry on later.

Salary, a second employer, a house, shares and funds, a property sale, crypto, a business, foreign income, days abroad, arrears, last year's losses, a revised return - in plain words, the section small beneath.

steps.chapter: Small business - only a bank statement
steps.say: A trainer, a tutor, a shop-keeper with no books and no Form 16? Pick Small business - only a bank statement. The statement is the only document, and the form is ITR-4 on a fixed share of receipts.

For a business: trading, manufacturing, services, a profession or farming; GST or not; a small turnover on the presumptive basis or full books; a tax audit with Form 3CD; partners' salary and interest; stock; depreciation.
The form follows from the picks, with its reason in one line - ITR-1, 2, 3 or 4 for a person or an HUF, ITR-5 for a firm, an LLP or an AOP, ITR-6 for a company.
Needed, good to have, and what you type in - each with what it is and where to get it: TRACES, the AIS, your employer, CAMS or KFintech, the GST portal, the firm's deed and its books.
Several at once. Each file is identified by what it is - a Form 16, an AIS, a GST certificate, a deed, the books - with its PAN, name and year; a file it cannot read says so.

The first document with a PAN makes the client, or finds the one already in your register. A popup asks only what is missing or does not agree: whose PAN, a date of birth, an HUF's Karta, a firm's partners from its deed, residence.
Fund sales in the AIS - upload the CAMS statement. Another employer's TAN - that Form 16. A firm with GST - its GSTR-3B. Each hint goes once it is answered.
What was understood, what is still missing, and one button on: My return at the right step for a person, Intake & map or the next firm screen for a business - never a dead end.
